title: Registration
requirement: If customer wants to buy the product then he/she must be registered, unregistered user can’t go to the shopping cart.

title: Login
requirement: Customer logins to the system by entering valid user id and password for the shopping.

title: Changes to Cart
requirement: Changes to cart means the customer after login or registration can make order or cancel order of the product from the shopping cart.

title: Payment
requirement: In this system we are dealing the mode of payment by Cash.We will extend this to credit card,debit card etc in the future.

title: Logout
requirement: After ordering or surfing for the product customer has to logout.

title: Report Generation
requirement: After ordering for the product,the system will sent one copy of the bill to the customer’s Email-address and another one for the system data base.
